name: cotidie
description: Cotidie's custom Codex skills: PR writing, iteration roadmaps, UML class diagrams, slide design extraction, React scaffolding, refactoring, textbook study notes, PACES paper summaries and visual paper study pages.

interface.shortDescription: Custom Codex workflows for PR writing, iteration roadmaps, UML class diagrams, slide design extraction, React scaffolding, refactoring, textbook study notes, PACES paper summaries and visual paper study pages.
interface.longDescription: Cotidie's Codex plugin bundles reusable workflow skills for drafting pull request text, planning vertical user-testable iterations, creating UML class diagrams as draw.io files, reverse-engineering reference slides into a reusable DESIGN.md visual design system, scaffolding or refactoring React apps, slimming codebases and fixing their module boundaries, distilling textbook chapter PDFs into Notion-style study notes, reading research papers with the PACES method into summaries with figures, and turning one paper into a visual study page with ManimGX animations.
capabilities: Draft PR and MR titles and bodies
Create UML class diagrams as draw.io files
Reverse-engineer reference slides into a reusable DESIGN.md design system
Scaffold or refactor React apps with bundled conventions
Slim a codebase and fix function, file, and module boundaries
Distill textbook chapter PDFs into Notion-style study notes
Summarize a research paper with PACES into Markdown or HTML with figures
Turn one paper into a visual study page with animations and offline HTML
